white-tailed-deer.description: The raised white tail gives a small alert flick; the eye briefly closes.

black-bear.description: One rounded ear settles a pixel before a slow blink.

red-fox.description: The white-tipped brush flicks upward while the fox gives a quick blink.

river-otter.description: The narrow tail tip sweeps gently upward, followed by a blink.

northern-cardinal.description: The pointed tail feathers make a small upward flick; the bird blinks.

bald-eagle.description: The outer wing feathers settle a pixel while the head stays steady, then the eye closes.

great-blue-heron.description: A tiny crest twitch and a watchful blink preserve the still hunting posture.

pileated-woodpecker.description: The red crest tilts slightly without moving the gripping feet; the bird blinks.

woodland-box-turtle.description: A front foot shifts under the domed shell before a slow blink.

central-ratsnake.description: A small tongue retraction and fork flick; the snake keeps its lidless eye open.

five-lined-skink.description: The blue tail tip gives a small upward twitch, then the lizard blinks.

painted-turtle.description: One tucked foot shifts a pixel while the striped shell remains still, followed by a blink.

american-bullfrog.description: The pale throat gently expands, then both eyes briefly close.

spotted-salamander.description: The tapered tail sweeps a pixel to either side while a rear foot shifts.

red-spotted-newt.description: The orange eft flexes its tail and lightly repositions a rear foot.

spring-peeper.description: A tiny foot taps, followed by a quick, paired eye blink.

brook-trout.description: The orange tail fans up and down as the dorsal fin changes angle.

largemouth-bass.description: The tail beats in a slow rhythm while the top fin subtly flexes.

bluegill.description: The forked tail paddles while the lower fin gives a small counterstroke.

channel-catfish.description: The tail sweeps gently; the longest whiskers twitch independently.

monarch.description: Both wings fold toward the body and open in a measured flutter.

tiger-swallowtail.description: The striped wings and hindwing tails draw inward, then spread again.

green-darner.description: Four wings flick inward around a stable green thorax and segmented abdomen.

horseshoe-crab.description: The long tail shifts side to side with a small twitch of the rear edges.
